title: Compliance Finding event (control-attestation telemetry for the operator's control-effectiveness self-assessment)
summary: OCSF Compliance Finding events the operator's control catalog emits at each control attestation. Carries the per-control attestation outcome (effective / partially effective / ineffective) and the attestation timestamp so the kri.control_effectiveness@v1 indicator can compute residual exposure as the share of in-scope controls NOT in the effective state. Same OCSF class the operator's regulator-notification chain emits at CRA timeline-signal milestones; this catalog entry pins the attestation-side source-data shape the control-effectiveness KRI reads.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Findings category — Compliance Finding class (uid 2003)
